description:
Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic for Saturday 8 Dhū l-Qaʿda through Friday 14 Dhū l-Qaʿda. Related to tax collection? The names mostly do not sound Jewish, and several are Christian. Very neatly tabulated with four column headers: (1) "the names" (al-asmāʾ); (2) "the agency" (? al-wakāla); (3) "the bureau" (al-dīwān); (4) "the farms" (? al-mazāriʿ). The entry "Abū l-Faḍl Ibn Qūrī: 5 1/3" has been inserted above the column headers. 

Names for the 8th: Yaḥyā [...]; Ḥassān b. [...]; Muhayyaʾ b. Manṣūr; Abū l-Bishr b. Ḥassān; Barakāt b. Ḥassān; Abū l-Ḥasan b. Mursī(?); Manṣūr b. Ḥusayn. 

For the 10th: ʿAskar b. Miftāḥ(?); 

For the 11th: [...]l b. al-Khaymī(?); Yanāl and his partner; Sulṭān b. Futūḥ. 

For the 12th: Muḥammad b. Yabqā; ʿAlī b. Yabqā; Makhlūf b. Kuḥl; ʿAṭiyya b. Malīḥ. 

For the 13th: ʿAbbūd b. Yaʿlā; Ghiyāth b. Kayl; Salmān b. ʿAllūn. 

For the 14th: Isḥāq al-Qiss; Yūnus b. Sayyid; Abū l-Futūḥ.
description_he: חשבונות ביהודית-ערבית. מוזכרים שמות רבים, ובהם מחמד, אסחאק אל-קס ('הכומר') וסולטאן בן פתוח.
